title:
Epic that handles redirecting from the Alert Details page to the Analysis page,
transferring filter panel data and ensuring the analysis is initialized with the correct context.

**Behavior:**
- Reads the current filter panel data from the Alert Details page.
- Navigates the user to the Analysis page.
- Waits for the Analysis Filter Panel to load.
- Configures the Analysis Filter Panel with the transferred data.
- Initiates plotting of the analysis results.
name: RedirectAlertDetailToAnalysisPageEpic
